# Addendum to WRITER.md (read WRITER.md first, then this)

Write 350 strings (not 300). Spread the mix as in WRITER.md, and in addition:
- About 40 percent should have surrounding words the way people really type into an event, reminder, booking, or chat box: the thing being scheduled ("dentist thurs 3pm"), a request ("pls book me in for mon 7:30am", "can we do next thursday at 4"), a reaction ("ok bet 4 pm"), or a note ("ill be there fri at 12"). The date or time part must still be unambiguous.
- Use slang and shorthand from your personas: tonite, tmrw, arvo, smoko, cob, eod, ish, sharp, o'clock, half six, quarter past, "come monday", "this coming sat", "the week after next".
- Include times written in many ways: 7a, 11p, 1730 hrs, oh nine hundred, 7.30pm, 19h, 0730, "7 in the morning", "ten to nine".
- Include 10 percent that are short (1-2 words), 10 percent that are long (8-12 words), the rest medium.
- Avoid repeating a sentence pattern more than a few times. Vary the event words, the order of date and time, and the filler.
